form.label: Save to GitHub
form.description: Commit the current lab configuration (including dashboards created this session) to a NEW branch on GitHub, for you to review and merge into main.

search.query: | makeresults | eval branch=if("$branch$"=="","lab-snapshot","$branch$") | eval _key=strftime(now(),"%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")."-".substr(md5(branch.tostring(now())),1,4) | eval message="$message$", status="pending", requested_by="admin", requested_at=strftime(now(),"%F %T"), updated_at=requested_at | outputlookup git_save_requests_lk append=true | eval Queued="Queued a save to branch '".branch."'. The pusher runs every ~30s - watch the status below." | table Queued branch _key

| inputlookup git_save_requests_lk | sort - requested_at | eval commit=if(isnull(commit),"",commit), result=if(isnull(result),"",result) | rename requested_at as "Requested", branch as "Branch", status as "Status", result as "Result", commit as "Commit", requested_by as "By" | table "Requested" "Branch" "Status" "Result" "Commit" "By" | head 15

ul.li: Create or edit dashboards in the lab apps as usual — Splunk saves them into the app.
Come here, type a branch name (e.g. added-dashboard) and a short description, then click Submit.

The request is queued; a background job (runs in splunkd, so it can reach GitHub — the browser/search sandbox cannot) creates that branch off main, commits the current lab apps, and pushes it. Status appears above within ~30s.
Open the branch on GitHub, review it, and merge into main — the next session pulls main and includes it.

html.p: Admin-only. Requires a GitHub token on the box (see the repo README, "Save to GitHub"). If you see a no token error in the status, the token wasn't provided at session start. Branch names are slugified; if the name already exists a timestamp is appended so nothing is overwritten.
